title: Restriction and division of section fractions
statement: Let X be a scheme, L an invertible module, s a global section, F a module, and U an open on which s is a free generator. Then restriction followed by division by powers of s defines an additive map from the section-fraction presentation to Γ(U,F), compatible with scalar restriction and satisfying tmul(f(t/s^n),s^n)=t|U.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PW, canonical map in part (2)

proof.text: For each n, tensoring sections with the n-th tensor power of the free generator is bijective. Use its inverse after restriction to define a linear map on each direct-sum summand. The tensor-power associativity identity shows the map kills every fraction relation, so it descends to the quotient. The inverse identity gives the displayed tensor formula, and linearity gives scalar compatibility.
